pr_title: Searchable snapshots mounted in the 'hot' phase should be pinned to hot nodes
pr_body:
Closes #72340

Some bits of this have the effect of reverting or altering some parts of #68861 (which itself closed #68635) -- so I added @andreidan as a reviewer to make sure he agrees with where we landed here.
pr_comments: `testSearchableSnapshotActionOverridesMigrateAction` is going to fail on this CI run (and indeed it also [fails locally](https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/vyo4jcysfk7rq)) -- I need to figure out what to do about that one.

issue_context.title: Searchable snapshots mounted in the 'hot' phase should be pinned to hot nodes
issue_context.body:
We added the ability to allow mounting an index from an ILM policy in the `hot` phase after rollover, however, these indices are automatically sent to the cold nodes. We need to change ILM such that we pass in `_tier_preference: data_hot` when they are mounted in the hot phase.

We'll also want to ensure they are migrated between phases appropriately.
